contribution: So sánh hệ thống 7 thuật toán ML cổ điển (DT, KNN, RF, NB, AB, LR, SVM) cộng 3 biến thể Neural Network trên PIMA; dùng Pearson correlation (cutoff 0.2) chọn 5 feature, kết luận NN 2 lớp ẩn đạt accuracy cao nhất.
method: Mean imputation -> IQR outlier removal (768->699 mau) -> Pearson feature selection (cutoff 0.2, giu 5 feature: Glucose/BMI/Insulin/Preg/Age) -> chuan hoa min-max [0,1] -> danh gia bang K-fold (10-fold) VA train/test split 85/15 (chay rieng); ML chay tren Weka, NN tren Keras/TensorFlow voi SGD (lr=0.01), RELU+sigmoid.
best_metric: Accuracy 88.6% — NN 2 lop an, 400 epoch, lr=0.01 (train/test split 85/15, Bang 8); ML tot nhat: KNN & AdaBoost 79.42% (split, Bang 6). Luu y: NN 2HL o 10-fold CV chi ~76% (Muc 4.2); KHONG cong bo AUC dang so (chi co ROC o Fig.11).
vs_baseline: Don gian hon hasan2020 (ensemble AUC-weighted AB+XB, AUC 0.950, CV phan tang, code public): bai nay khong ensemble, khong AUC dang so, khong xu ly imbalance, khong code. NN dat 88.6% acc nhung chi 1 lan split — K-fold tut con ~76%, kem on dinh hon AUC 0.950 cua hasan2020. Khac he hoan toan voi li2020_behrt (Transformer EHR long-term, multi-label 301 benh) — khong so truc tiep duoc.
gap: Imputation + Pearson feature selection + normalize fit tren TOAN dataset truoc khi split (leakage nhe ~1-2%); khong xu ly mat can bang lop ~2:1; khong bao cao AUC/sensitivity/specificity; con so dinh 88.6% chi tu 1 lan split nen khong on dinh; khong seed + khong code public -> kho tai lap.
verdict_reason: Gia tri chinh la bang so sanh 7 ML + 3 NN tren PIMA (483 cite) dung lam reference; nhung con so best khong on dinh (88.6% split vs ~76% K-fold), thieu AUC, co leakage nhe va khong co code -> chua du manh de promote.
